review: Independent first assembled V29 proof; all 34 PDF-rendered page PNGs inspected individually at native export resolution, not only thumbnails.
score_definition: Internal craft judgment only. 4.9 is a near-final visual/readability target; it does not mean professional SLP approval, owner acceptance, child comprehension, physical print proof, or master-audit release-proven satisfaction.
scope: 34 pages including covers. Story and pagination unchanged. Preserve original source staging; local repair and marginal stationery performances only.
reference_comparison: The alternating full art and contour cutouts, quiet pale blue field, dotted perimeter, bilateral low blue banks, event-specific props and purposeful small character performances now match the original design language substantially better. Current owner constraints govern full-art/cutout treatment and marginal sizes.
review_limitations: Visible flattened bank silhouettes are measured; full pre-occlusion asset dimensions and exact hidden-area proportion cannot be independently recovered.
This review checks screen/PDF rendering. Physical 7×5 print legibility and color remain open.
Many native generation masters are 1484×1060, about 212ppi at 7×5. This is honest native resolution, not a 300ppi print claim.
geometric_bank_result: Nine selected new banks pass visible top-85%, individual 12%-width/height and central 38–62% void checks per bank_annotations.json. Original preserved 11/21 banks require separate derivative scrutiny after the proposed whole-background bubble repair.

bubble_and_compression.visual_result: New blue perimeter rings are closed and crisp. Dense full-art bubble piles contain intact painted highlights; blue mottling and fine speckle read as watercolor, not a JPEG block grid. No smeared ring cluster or corrupt contour was found in the native candidates or the inspected PDF renders.

pdf_encoding.note: Lossless PDF image embedding adds no JPEG recompression; pre-existing source artifacts would still require visual repair.

bubble_and_compression.actual_remaining_problem: Hard composite seams in 11/21 and 27–29 are separate from compression.

failures.description: White caption crosses very pale lavender column/arch pixels; final words lose separation.
failures.repair: Move caption into a calm dark/contrasting lane or apply a gentle continuous contrast underlay.

failures.description: White caption crosses peach highlights on 6 and gold/green caustic lines on 13.
failures.repair: Bounded calm floor/water patch or continuous layout contrast treatment; preserve scene staging.

failures.description: Text separation varies over shell paving, orange reflection, peach highlights, and pale side columns respectively.
failures.repair: A subtle continuous layout contrast treatment can address these without new scene art.

failures.description: Three hard bubble-perimeter patch edges expose a rectangular change in watercolor wash, strongest on 21.
failures.repair: Use a coherent integrated derivative or transition edge that preserves the exact main cutout and existing story-prop identities.

failures.description: Full-width hard join at rendered y≈229/1080; mismatched column tops and a partial second chandelier sit above the original chandelier.
failures.repair: Reuse the coherent approved scrub ceiling or restrict replacement to ceiling-only pixels with a continuous transition. Preserve all original lower-scene geometry.

failures.description: Dirty toy-storage doorway and the more formal playroom use visibly different architectures.
failures.repair: Explicit 'In the playroom' wording supplies the location bridge; preserve both established source scenes.

iteration: Root has already proposed repairs for caption lanes, coherent 11/21 stationery and approved scrub-ceiling reuse. Reinspect actual outputs before closing any finding.
No additional scene redesign is warranted for novelty; preserve accepted covers, source landing, main craft cutout and the event-specific native banks.
